name: Random Offset Annealed Fourier Encoding
definition: A positional encoding scheme that maps a 3D coordinate x to a higher-dimensional vector using L frequency basis functions, modified with random offsets and annealing to improve optimization landscape compared to standard NeRF encoding.
summary: Random Offset Annealed Fourier Encoding is a positional encoding scheme that adds random Gaussian offsets to Fourier frequencies to eliminate axis-aligned striping artifacts while maintaining optimization stability.
